ValidationRule.description: This is a validation, when the Awaiting Customer or 3rd Party Feedback flag is checked, the reason is mandatory
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
((ISCHANGED(Awaiting_Customer_Feedback__c) && Awaiting_Customer_Feedback__c==true && ISBLANK(TEXT(BUA_Reason__c))) ||(Awaiting_Customer_Feedback__c==true && ISBLANK(TEXT(Reason)) && TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Reason))!='') ) && TEXT( Region_Flag__c ) = 'Bahrain' && $User.LastName <> "Integration" && NOT(ISNEW()) &&
(RecordType_DeveloperName__c = 'Service_Request' || RecordType_DeveloperName__c = 'Issue' || RecordType_DeveloperName__c = 'Enquiry' || RecordType_DeveloperName__c = 'Complaint' || RecordType_DeveloperName__c = 'Internal_Case' || RecordType_DeveloperName__c = 'New_Update_Customer_Profile' || RecordType_DeveloperName__c = 'Customer_Profile_Update' || RecordType_DeveloperName__c = 'Feedback' || RecordType_DeveloperName__c = 'Update_Customer_Profile' || RecordType_DeveloperName__c = 'Manual_Customer_Archival' || RecordType_DeveloperName__c = 'Premium_Retention' || RecordType_DeveloperName__c = 'Premium_Invitation' || RecordType_DeveloperName__c = 'ac_AccountClosure' || RecordType_DeveloperName__c = 'Prizeout' || RecordType_DeveloperName__c = 'Subscription_Model_Termination' || RecordType_DeveloperName__c = 'Request' || RecordType_DeveloperName__c = 'Case_Enquiries' || RecordType_DeveloperName__c = 'Case_Disputes_and_Frauds' || RecordType_DeveloperName__c = 'Case_Faults_and_Incidents' || (RecordType_DeveloperName__c = 'Credit_Card_Services' && TEXT(Type) != 'Credit Card Invitation' && TEXT(cc_Checker_Result__c) != 'Request to Pay Outstanding Balance') )
